briefing: Markets slipped slightly today (NASDAQ -0.6%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a mild, neutral session with no clear risk-off signal. With $646 in idle cash and 3 open slots, we're making one medium-conviction buy in RH, which has all four momentum signals and room to run before it looks overbought. We're holding all existing positions and letting the automatic stop-losses and profit targets do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means you only buy when several different indicators agree, not just one. Today RH showed a bullish MACD crossover, healthy RSI momentum, a price above its 20-day average and unusually high trading volume all at once. When signals line up like this, a move is more likely to be real buying by big investors than a random one-day spike, which matters most on quiet, directionless days.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「多重訊號確認」是指只有在多項技術指標同時發出一致訊號時才入市，而非單憑一個指標下決定。今日RH同時出現MACD黃金交叉、RSI動能健康、股價企穩20日均線之上，以及成交量顯著放大。多項訊號互相印證，代表升勢較可能由大型機構資金推動，而非一時的偶然波動；在方向未明的淡靜市況下，這種確認尤其重要。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks edged lower today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ falling 0.6% and the S&P 500 slipping 0.3%. No news headlines were provided for this session, so we can't name a specific cause, but moves this small usually reflect routine profit-taking and position adjustments rather than a change in market direction. Large-cap chip names like NVDA, MU and AMD are trading below their 20-day averages, which points to softness in semiconductors weighing on the NASDAQ more than on the broader index.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回落，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌0.6%，標普500指數則微跌0.3%。由於本節未有提供新聞資料，暫難確定具體誘因，但如此溫和的跌幅，一般反映市場例行獲利回吐及倉位調整，而非趨勢逆轉。輝達（NVDA）、美光（MU）及超微（AMD）等大型晶片股均跌穿20日均線，顯示半導體板塊疲弱，對納指的拖累明顯大於大市。

trades.reasoning: RH has all four confirmation signals (MACD bullish crossover with a rising histogram, RSI 57.6 well below overbought, price above its 20-day average, and a volume surge), so it is the best use of the idle cash in an open slot.
